title: Your online teammate wants to “borrow” your login
scenario: A teammate you have played with for months says their account is temporarily banned and asks to use yours for one tournament match. They offer to send you a rare item afterward.

answers.A: Ask whether the tournament allows substitutes and help them find another solution.
answers.B: Share the account just for the match, then change the password immediately afterward.
answers.C: Do not share the account; suggest they use the game’s appeal process or sit out the match.

explanation: Trust built through play is real, but shared credentials can lead to bans, theft or account recovery problems.
proTip: Friendship does not make account sharing reversible.
